_comment: Copy this to config.json (or use the ARTEX_CONFIG environment variable to point at a different path). This file only contains database and skill_dir; LLM and other settings go through environment variables or in-app settings, not this file.
_comment_database: PostgreSQL connection. Priority: environment variable ARTEX_PG_DSN > database in this file. Choose one of two forms: (A) fill in the individual fields below; (B) fill in only database.dsn as a single complete connection string.
_comment_database_dsn: Form (B): remove the database above and use a full DSN instead. When dsn is non-empty, the individual fields are ignored.
_comment_skill_dir: Skill root directory (each subdirectory is one skill, containing SKILL.md). Priority: environment variable ARTEX_SKILL_DIR > this field > default (skills/ next to the executable). Leave blank or remove this field to use the default. Relative paths are resolved against the current working directory.
